package.name: corridor_perception_c
package.description: The C port of corridor_perception.extraction.extract_segments: one shared library, one call per scan, no allocation in the hot path. C11, no external dependencies, no ROS at build or run time - corridor_perception loads it through ctypes and falls back to the Python if it is absent. A port, not a design: every threshold, tie-break and output order follows extraction.py, and an equivalence test over a whole recording says so.
